Little franks in soft buns under beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, ballpark style. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water, and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Simmer 12 cocktail franks 3 minutes. Split 12 mini hot dog buns, add a frank, spoon over the chilli and top with 100g grated cheddar and diced onion. Grill 1 minute to melt.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 2 days ahead; assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until just tender, drain, cool and dress with the soy, olive oil and lemon juice.
Warm the blini on a tray at 180C.
Top each with crème fraîche, then a spoon of the lentils and chives.
Serve straight away while warm.

Whisk with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in 200g of the warm clarified butter for the béarnaise.
Sear the steaks to medium rare, then rest.
Split the lobster tails and brush with garlic butter made from the remaining butter.

steps.text: Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon to a few spoonfuls.

Brush the mushrooms with the oil, sear 4 minutes a side, then rest.
Brush the haloumi with garlic butter made from the garlic and the remaining butter.

Bake at 160C until pale.
Cool completely.
Mix the rest of the icing sugar with a drop of water and pipe a little stamp design on each.

s.n: Prawn cocktail for the whole hotel
s.note: Iced prawns on crisp iceberg with Marie Rose and paprika
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water with lemon and a bay leaf for 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 2 tbsp tomato sauce and a squeeze of lemon. Serve on shredded iceberg in glasses, dusted with paprika.

s.note: Warm blini with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives
s.how: Warm 16 buckwheat blini on a tray at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, about 150ml in total, then half a teaspoon of salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Serve straight away while they are still warm.

m.note: Eye fillet and grilled lobster tail with béarnaise
m.how: Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon to 2 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over a low heat and drizzle in 200g warm clarified butter. Sear 4 eye fillet steaks to medium rare and rest. Split 2 lobster tails, brush with garlic butter and grill for 6 minutes.

w.note: Buttery shortbread cut like stamps, with a piped design
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g icing sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour and 60g rice flour. Roll to 6mm, cut into rectangles with a pinking cutter and bake at 160C for 20 minutes. Cool and pipe a little stamp design on each with icing.
